title: Review findings
description: The file that a review role writes: `.tmp/review/<short-head-sha>/<role>.json` on the machine of the author, and `<role>.json` in the artifact of CI (ADR 0017, decision 5).

role.description: The name of the folder of the role under `.github/review/`.

head.description: The short or full SHA of the commit under review.

base.description: The branch or the SHA that the diff is taken from.

verdict.description: `PASS` when no finding reaches `blocking`, `FAIL` when one does, `INCONCLUSIVE` when the role could not do its review.

findings.description: The most severe first, at most `max-findings`.

not_checked.description: What the role did not review, and why.

commands.description: The commands the role ran and what each returned.

id.description: The role and a number, such as `security-1`. `review-refute` keeps it.

severity.description: `P0` breaks production, loses data or opens a security hole on the normal path. `P1` is wrong behaviour that a user or a caller reaches. `P2` is wrong on an edge case, or a gap that makes a later bug likely. `P3` is worth knowing and never blocks.

path.description: The file of the finding, from the root of the repository.

line.description: The first line of the finding in `path`, counted from 1.

title.description: One sentence that says what is wrong.

evidence.description: What in the code shows it, and the smallest case that breaks it.

reproduced.description: Whether the role ran the case: `yes`, `no` (it ran and the case passed) or `not-tried`.

how_to_verify.description: Commands or steps that a person runs to check the finding. A runner of CI never runs them.

result.description: What the command returned, such as `pass` or `fail`.
